english.title: Revenue trader fail to provide appliances / facilities to enable officer to perform duties
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a

(A)_[revenue trader]_
(B)_[person required by the Commissioners under the Customs and Excise Acts 1979 to give security in respect of premises or a place to be used for the examination of goods by an officer]_

failed to provide and maintain such appliances and afford such facilities reasonably necessary to enable an officer to take account, make an examination or search or perform such duties

(C)_[on your premises]_
(D)_[at the bonded premises]_
(E)_[at a place directed by the Commissioners]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES / PLACE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 158(1)(a) and (2) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
